about: The callo builds the figures were measured on, in the order they were made. A plate and FIGURES.md name a build by its role, never by its commit: the commits are of callo's development history, which is not published, so they do not resolve in the public repository. FIGURES.md lists them once, under Development builds.

builds.name: the refit build
builds.what: the temperature fit's grid widened from 0.25–4 to 0.25–16; calibrations measured on the first build were refit with it, offline

builds.name: the readout-fix build
builds.what: the readout fix: an answer slot whose top token ends the turn is read there, the token never appended; every readout pass pins a neutral sampler

builds.name: the early-exit build
builds.what: early exit (--think-converge) and calibrate's convergence probe

builds.name: the gate build
builds.what: early exit's gate (--think-converge-gate) and calibrate's gated early-exit points

builds.name: the gate-reads build
builds.what: calibrate --resume adds the gate's reads to a calibration measured before the gate
